checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals web-design-spec, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals web-design-spec.

checks.description: The spec sets a responsive grid, named breakpoints (mobile first), and a type scale.
checks.rule: Output includes a grid, named breakpoints declared mobile first, and a type scale.

checks.description: Design tokens use the exact brand visual constants for color, plus spacing and radius.
checks.rule: Tokens name #141414 background, #1A1A1A surfaces, and #009975 accent, and include spacing and radius scales.

checks.description: RTL behavior is specified at every breakpoint: direction rtl, Arabic primary, mixed direction held.
checks.rule: The rtl field specifies direction rtl at every breakpoint, Arabic primary, Western numerals, and mixed-direction handling.

checks.description: Interaction states are specified: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error.
checks.rule: The states field names default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, and error for interactive elements.

checks.description: Accessibility is specified: contrast, focus order, semantic structure, touch targets, alt text slots.
checks.rule: The accessibility field names contrast, focus order, semantic structure, touch target sizing, and alt text slots.

checks.description: A performance budget is stated: fast first render, minimal blocking assets, image weight, mobile primary-action placement.
checks.rule: The performance field states a render budget, minimal blocking assets, image weight, and the primary action visible without a scroll on mobile.

checks.description: Every copy region binds to a QA-passed copy-package variant id; no free copy is written in the spec.
checks.rule: Output includes copy_refs binding each region to a variant id, and a hard rule that copy is never invented in the spec.

checks.description: The spec carries exactly one primary action per view.
checks.rule: Components and hard rules state one primary action per view, not two competing CTAs.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals.

checks.description: Never imply accreditation; never invent Skill Path titles, instructor names, offers, or prices; never put personal data in tracking.
checks.rule: Hard rules forbid accreditation implication, invented titles, names, offers, or prices, and personal or sensitive data in URL parameters or tracking.

checks.description: The output populates the design_spec field of the web-design-package.
checks.rule: Output is described as the design_spec field of the web-design-package.
